notes: Variant assumption is a moderate-incline dumbbell chest press, not a high-incline shoulder press. Pectoralis major is primary; anterior deltoid and triceps are secondary. Biceps brachii, serratus anterior, and rotator cuff are marked as support from close dumbbell or bench-press evidence where exact incline dumbbell-only measurements were unavailable. No visible upper trapezius role was added despite direct measurement in Luczak et al. because it did not provide a clear app target or support role for this chest movement. No anatomy blockers found.
